Boundaries.Name: blocking-asking-transport
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the blocking caller's retry history. Retain ASKING failure, drain both FIFO replies, and restore watchdog suppression before final caller inspection. Never arm a blocking command deadline.

Boundaries.Name: physical-connect-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Physical attempts borrow setup ownership. Recovered connection attempts are handled retries; pool generations do not create caller ownership. Caller cancellation preserves its token and is not an independent physical error. Handshake and validation cleanup preserve the original failure.

Boundaries.Name: physical-testing-connect-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Testing transport setup follows the same caller boundary as socket setup. Factory, handshake and validation cleanup preserve original errors and cancellation tokens; an observed physical close does not create another setup caller.

Boundaries.Name: physical-disconnect-publication
Boundaries.Contract: Only the winning physical close publishes one internal error, outside the write gate. This physical event is independent of logical caller retry counts. Idle sockets, successful calls and already-cancelled callers acquire no additional final caller failure.

Boundaries.Name: physical-pending-drain
Boundaries.Contract: Drain each FIFO slot once after admission closes. Offer the original physical error to pending completions and release only the native receive reference. A completed caller rejects replacement; caller inspection keeps its own final publication and original cancellation token.
